# Permanent Fixtures

This directory contains exactly four permanent, fictional, fully anonymized
fixtures:

- [Incomplete project](incomplete-project/README.md)
- [Contradictory project](contradictory-project/README.md)
- [Application modernization](application-modernization/README.md)
- [New application](new-application/README.md)

Each fixture README inventories the heterogeneous source artefacts passed to
the skill under test. The README itself is fixture metadata, not project
source material. Expected behavior belongs in the matching scenario, not in
the source.

Fixture structures intentionally reflect their consulting contexts rather than
following one artificial document template.

Do not add another permanent fixture. Temporary data must remain outside this
directory and must satisfy the same anonymization rules.
